provenance.metric_definition: cosine and max(abs(candidate-reference))/max(abs(reference)), flattened over every element of the named site for one specimen; aggregates are arithmetic means across the seven one-per-class specimens

localization.source_mechanism: _float_layer observes post-qk_norm/post-RoPE K under the raw layer0.k key; _projection_scale later converts that union maximum into the pre-norm K landing scale
